items.question: Trong câu "The two overlap less than you would expect.", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two overlap less than you would expect.", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to share part of the same area
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (động từ): trùng nhau một phần. "The two overlap" = hai thứ trùng nhau một phần; danh từ: an overlap (phần giao nhau).
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊ.vəˈlæp/ (verb): to share part of the same area. "The two overlap" means they share some ground; noun: an overlap.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers rarely describe a problem.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers rarely describe a problem.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. Trạng từ tần suất: always > usually > often > sometimes > rarely > never.
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (adverb): not often. Frequency adverbs: always > usually > often > sometimes > rarely > never.

items.question: Trong câu "They describe the solution they already imagined — based on what they know, what they saw in other software, or how they do it manually today.", từ "imagine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They describe the solution they already imagined — based on what they know, what they saw in other software, or how they do it manually today.", what does "imagine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imagine /ɪˈmædʒ.ɪn/ (động từ): hình dung. "The solution they already imagined" = giải pháp họ đã hình dung sẵn trong đầu.
items.explanationEn: imagine /ɪˈmædʒ.ɪn/ (verb): to picture in the mind. "The solution they already imagined" is the one they pictured before talking to you.

items.question: Trong câu "They describe the solution they already imagined — based on what they know, what they saw in other software, or how they do it manually today.", từ "manually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They describe the solution they already imagined — based on what they know, what they saw in other software, or how they do it manually today.", what does "manually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: manually /ˈmæn.ju.ə.li/ (trạng từ): thủ công, bằng tay. "Do it manually" = làm thủ công; đối lập: automatically; tính từ: manual.
items.explanationEn: manually /ˈmæn.ju.ə.li/ (adverb): by hand. "Do it manually" means by hand; the opposite is automatically; adjective: manual.

items.question: Trong câu "That is entirely natural and not their fault.", từ "entirely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is entirely natural and not their fault.", what does "entirely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪə.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Entirely natural / different" = hoàn toàn tự nhiên / khác biệt; đồng nghĩa: completely.
items.explanationEn: entirely /ɪnˈtaɪə.li/ (adverb): completely. "Entirely natural / different" means completely so.

items.question: Trong câu "That is entirely natural and not their fault.", từ "natural" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is entirely natural and not their fault.", what does "natural" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: natural /ˈnætʃ.ər.əl/ (tính từ): bình thường, dễ hiểu. "It is natural that..." = việc … là dễ hiểu; khách hàng mô tả giải pháp là chuyện bình thường.
items.explanationEn: natural /ˈnætʃ.ər.əl/ (adjective): normal and expected. "It is natural that..." means it is to be expected; customers describing solutions is normal.

items.question: Trong câu "More abstract, about a business outcome", từ "abstract" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More abstract, about a business outcome", what does "abstract" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: abstract /ˈæb.strækt/ (tính từ): trừu tượng, khái quát. "Abstract" đối lập "concrete"; danh từ abstract còn có nghĩa khác là bản tóm tắt.
items.explanationEn: abstract /ˈæb.strækt/ (adjective): general, not concrete. "Abstract" is the opposite of "concrete"; as a noun it can also mean a summary.

items.question: Trong câu "More abstract, about a business outcome", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More abstract, about a business outcome", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Business outcome" = kết quả kinh doanh mong muốn; "desired outcome" = kết quả mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): a final result. "A business outcome" is the result the business wants; "desired outcome" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA draws it out through dialogue", từ "dialogue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA draws it out through dialogue", what does "dialogue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): cuộc trao đổi. Dialogue (Anh-Anh) / dialog (Anh-Mỹ); "open a dialogue with" = bắt đầu trao đổi với.
items.explanationEn: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (noun): a conversation between people. Dialogue (UK) / dialog (US); "open a dialogue with" means starting a conversation.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Reveal a problem / an insight" = làm lộ ra vấn đề / hiểu biết mới.
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make known. "Reveal a problem / an insight" means bringing it to light.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. "Propose a solution" = đề xuất giải pháp; danh từ: proposal (bản đề xuất).
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (verb): to put forward an idea. "Propose a solution" means putting it forward; noun: proposal.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", từ "route" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the NEED usually reveals a cheaper, faster, more effective route than the one they proposed.", what does "route" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way to reach a goal
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (danh từ): cách đi, hướng giải quyết. "A cheaper route" = một cách rẻ hơn để đạt mục tiêu; nghĩa đen là tuyến đường.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (noun): a way to reach a goal. "A cheaper route" is a less costly way to the goal; literally, a road or path.

items.question: Trong câu "Each question steps back from solution toward problem.", từ "step back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each question steps back from solution toward problem.", what does "step back" (phrase) mean?
options: lùi lại để nhìn rộng hơn
optionsEn: to move back to see more
items.explanation: step back /step bæk/ (cụm từ): lùi lại để nhìn rộng hơn. "Take a step back" = lùi lại một bước để nhìn toàn cảnh; câu hay dùng trong họp.
items.explanationEn: step back /step bæk/ (phrase): to move back to see more. "Take a step back" means pausing to see the bigger picture; common in meetings.

items.question: Trong câu "exposes the actual process and its workarounds.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exposes the actual process and its workarounds.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Expose a weakness / a process" = phơi bày điểm yếu / quy trình; danh từ: exposure.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to bring into view. "Expose a weakness / a process" means making it visible; noun: exposure.

items.question: Trong câu "measures frequency and therefore reasonable investment.", từ "frequency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "measures frequency and therefore reasonable investment.", what does "frequency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rate of a radio wave
items.explanation: frequency /ˈfriː.kwən.si/ (danh từ): tần suất. Tần suất cao thì đáng đầu tư nhiều hơn; tính từ: frequent (thường xuyên).
items.explanationEn: frequency /ˈfriː.kwən.si/ (noun): how often something happens. Higher frequency justifies more investment; adjective: frequent.

items.question: Trong câu "measures frequency and therefore reasonable investment.", từ "reasonable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "measures frequency and therefore reasonable investment.", what does "reasonable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reasonable /ˈriː.zən.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, vừa phải. "A reasonable price / investment" = giá / khoản đầu tư hợp lý.
items.explanationEn: reasonable /ˈriː.zən.ə.bəl/ (adjective): fair and sensible. "A reasonable price / investment" is fair and not too much.

items.question: Trong câu "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", từ "unaware" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", what does "unaware" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unaware /ˌʌn.əˈweər/ (tính từ): không nhận thức được. "Be unaware of something" = không biết, không để ý đến điều gì; trái nghĩa: aware.
items.explanationEn: unaware /ˌʌn.əˈweər/ (adjective): not conscious of. "Be unaware of something" means not knowing it; opposite: aware.

items.question: Trong câu "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", từ "irritating" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", what does "irritating" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: irritating /ˈɪr.ɪ.teɪ.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): gây khó chịu. "Irritating steps" = các bước gây bực mình; đồng nghĩa: annoying.
items.explanationEn: irritating /ˈɪr.ɪ.teɪ.tɪŋ/ (adjective): annoying. "Irritating steps" are annoying ones; synonym: annoying.

items.question: Trong câu "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", từ "tolerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People working by habit are usually unaware of the steps they take, and even less aware of the irritating steps they have learned to tolerate.", what does "tolerate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take a drug without harm
items.explanation: tolerate /ˈtɒl.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): cam chịu, chịu đựng. "Tolerate a problem" = cam chịu vấn đề; danh từ: tolerance.
items.explanationEn: tolerate /ˈtɒl.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to put up with. "Tolerate a problem" means accepting it without complaint; noun: tolerance.

items.question: Trong câu "Every spreadsheet, notebook, and internal chat message running alongside the official system is an unmet NEED.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every spreadsheet, notebook, and internal chat message running alongside the official system is an unmet NEED.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal chat / meeting" = nhóm chat / cuộc họp nội bộ; đối lập: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): within the organization. "An internal chat / meeting" stays inside the company; opposite: external.

items.question: Trong câu "They have endured a pain point so long it feels normal.", từ "endure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They have endured a pain point so long it feels normal.", what does "endure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: endure /ɪnˈdjʊər/ (động từ): chịu đựng. "Endure a pain point" = chịu đựng một điểm khó chịu; lâu dần thành quen, không ai nêu ra.
items.explanationEn: endure /ɪnˈdjʊər/ (verb): to suffer patiently. "Endure a pain point" means living with it; over time it feels normal and nobody mentions it.

items.question: Trong câu "They never raise it as a requirement because they are used to it.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They never raise it as a requirement because they are used to it.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra. "Raise an issue / a concern" = nêu vấn đề / mối lo ngại; cụm rất hay dùng trong họp.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise an issue / a concern" means bringing it up; very common in meetings.

items.question: Trong câu "They never raise it as a requirement because they are used to it.", từ "be used to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They never raise it as a requirement because they are used to it.", what does "be used to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: be used to /biː juːst tuː/ (cụm từ): quen với. "Be used to + N / V-ing" = quen với; khác "used to + V" = đã từng làm.
items.explanationEn: be used to /biː juːst tuː/ (phrase): accustomed to. "Be used to + noun / -ing" means accustomed to; "used to + verb" means did in the past.

items.question: Trong câu "Because they consider it obvious, or assume it is not feasible.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because they consider it obvious, or assume it is not feasible.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): cho rằng. "Assume it is not feasible" = cho rằng không khả thi; danh từ: assumption (giả định).
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to suppose without proof. "Assume it is not feasible" means believing so without checking; noun: assumption.

items.question: Trong câu "Because they consider it obvious, or assume it is not feasible.", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because they consider it obvious, or assume it is not feasible.", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "Technically feasible" = khả thi về kỹ thuật; "feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi.
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): possible to do. "Technically feasible" means it can be built; "feasibility study" checks whether a project can work.

items.question: Trong câu "To catch all three: combine interviews, observation, and prototypes.", từ "combine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To catch all three: combine interviews, observation, and prototypes.", what does "combine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (động từ): kết hợp. "Combine A and B" = kết hợp A và B; danh từ: combination.
items.explanationEn: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (verb): to join together. "Combine A and B" means using them together; noun: combination.

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes you understand the NEED clearly but the customer insists on their WANT.", từ "insist on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes you understand the NEED clearly but the customer insists on their WANT.", what does "insist on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: insist on /ɪnˈsɪst ɒn/ (cụm từ): khăng khăng đòi. "Insist on something" = khăng khăng đòi điều gì; danh từ: insistence.
items.explanationEn: insist on /ɪnˈsɪst ɒn/ (phrase): to demand firmly. "Insist on something" means refusing to accept anything else; noun: insistence.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most delicate situation in the craft.", từ "delicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most delicate situation in the craft.", what does "delicate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: delicate /ˈdel.ɪ.kət/ (tính từ): tế nhị, khó xử. "A delicate situation / issue" = tình huống / vấn đề tế nhị, cần khéo léo.
items.explanationEn: delicate /ˈdel.ɪ.kət/ (adjective): needing careful handling. "A delicate situation / issue" needs tact and care.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most delicate situation in the craft.", từ "craft" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most delicate situation in the craft.", what does "craft" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: craft /krɑːft/ (danh từ): nghề (cần tay nghề). "The craft" = nghề nghiệp đòi hỏi kỹ năng tích lũy; "master your craft" = thành thạo nghề.
items.explanationEn: craft /krɑːft/ (noun): a skilled trade. "The craft" is a skilled occupation; "master your craft" means becoming expert at it.

items.question: Trong câu "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc. "Legal / budget constraint" = ràng buộc pháp lý / ngân sách; động từ: constrain.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limiting condition. "A legal / budget constraint" limits your options; verb: constrain.

items.question: Trong câu "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): cam kết. "Make a commitment to a customer" = cam kết với khách hàng; động từ: commit to.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise to do something. "Make a commitment to a customer" means promising something; verb: commit to.

items.question: Trong câu "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", từ "executive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There may be a legal constraint, a customer commitment, or an executive decision you have not heard about.", what does "executive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: executive /ɪɡˈzek.jə.tɪv/ (tính từ): thuộc cấp lãnh đạo. "An executive decision" = quyết định từ cấp lãnh đạo; danh từ executive = giám đốc điều hành.
items.explanationEn: executive /ɪɡˈzek.jə.tɪv/ (adjective): of senior management. "An executive decision" comes from senior management; the noun means a senior manager.

items.question: Trong câu "They do not believe the alternative will work.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They do not believe the alternative will work.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "Offer an alternative" = đưa ra phương án khác; tính từ: alternative (thay thế).
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another possible option. "Offer an alternative" means giving another option; also used as an adjective.

items.question: Trong câu "Seeing persuades better than explaining.", từ "persuade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Seeing persuades better than explaining.", what does "persuade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (động từ): thuyết phục. "Persuade someone to do something" = thuyết phục ai làm gì; tính từ: persuasive.
items.explanationEn: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (verb): to convince. "Persuade someone to do something" means convincing them; adjective: persuasive.

items.question: Trong câu "They already committed publicly to that solution.", từ "publicly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They already committed publicly to that solution.", what does "publicly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: publicly /ˈpʌb.lɪk.li/ (trạng từ): công khai. Đã cam kết "publicly" thì rút lại rất khó vì mất thể diện.
items.explanationEn: publicly /ˈpʌb.lɪk.li/ (adverb): in front of others. Backing out of something committed to publicly is hard because it means losing face.

items.question: Trong câu "Dropping it means admitting error in front of others.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dropping it means admitting error in front of others.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit a mistake / error" = thừa nhận sai lầm; danh từ: admission.
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to accept as true. "Admit a mistake / error" means accepting it was wrong; noun: admission.

items.question: Trong câu "Handle it: create a face-saving path.", từ "face-saving" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle it: create a face-saving path.", what does "face-saving" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: face-saving /ˈfeɪsˌseɪ.vɪŋ/ (tính từ): giữ thể diện. "A face-saving solution" = giải pháp giúp giữ thể diện; "lose face" = mất mặt.
items.explanationEn: face-saving /ˈfeɪsˌseɪ.vɪŋ/ (adjective): protecting one's dignity. "A face-saving solution" lets someone keep their dignity; "lose face" is the opposite.

items.question: Trong câu "You misunderstood the NEED.", từ "misunderstand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You misunderstood the NEED.", what does "misunderstand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstand /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstænd/ (động từ): hiểu sai. Tiền tố mis- = sai (misunderstand, misread); danh từ: misunderstanding.
items.explanationEn: misunderstand /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstænd/ (verb): to get the wrong meaning. The prefix mis- means wrongly (misunderstand, misread); noun: misunderstanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Handle it: stay humble.", từ "humble" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle it: stay humble.", what does "humble" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: humble /ˈhʌm.bəl/ (tính từ): khiêm tốn. "Stay humble" = giữ thái độ khiêm tốn; có thể chính BA mới là người hiểu sai.
items.explanationEn: humble /ˈhʌm.bəl/ (adjective): not proud. "Stay humble" means not assuming you are right; the BA may be the one who is wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "The final principle: if after a full trade-off discussion the customer still chooses their WANT, that is their right.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The final principle: if after a full trade-off discussion the customer still chooses their WANT, that is their right.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance of gains and losses
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off between speed and quality" = đánh đổi giữa tốc độ và chất lượng.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance of gains and losses. "Make a trade-off between speed and quality" means giving up some of one for the other.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the rationale and move on.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the rationale and move on.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do căn bản. "Document the rationale" = ghi lại lý do của quyết định, để sau này không phải tranh cãi lại.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind a decision. "Document the rationale" means writing down why a decision was made, so it is not reopened later.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the rationale and move on.", từ "move on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the rationale and move on.", what does "move on" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to go on to the next thing
items.explanation: move on /muːv ɒn/ (cụm từ): chuyển sang việc tiếp. "Let's move on to the next item" = chuyển sang mục tiếp theo; câu quen thuộc khi điều phối họp.
items.explanationEn: move on /muːv ɒn/ (phrase): to go on to the next thing. "Let's move on to the next item" is a common line when running a meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "Classifying correctly tells you what is negotiable.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classifying correctly tells you what is negotiable.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classify requirements" = phân loại yêu cầu; danh từ: classification.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to sort into groups. "Classify requirements" means sorting them into types; noun: classification.

items.question: Trong câu "Classifying correctly tells you what is negotiable.", từ "negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classifying correctly tells you what is negotiable.", what does "negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thương lượng. "Non-negotiable" = không thể thương lượng; động từ: negotiate.
items.explanationEn: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (adjective): open to discussion. "Non-negotiable" means fixed; verb: negotiate.

items.question: Trong câu "Tied to a business objective or real pain", từ "tied to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tied to a business objective or real pain", what does "tied to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (cụm từ): gắn liền với. "Tied to a business objective" = gắn với mục tiêu kinh doanh; "tied to a budget" = phụ thuộc ngân sách.
items.explanationEn: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (phrase): closely linked to. "Tied to a business objective" means linked to it; "tied to a budget" means dependent on it.

items.question: Trong câu "Tied to a business objective or real pain", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tied to a business objective or real pain", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "Business objective" = mục tiêu kinh doanh; tính từ objective = khách quan.
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (noun): an aim. "A business objective" is a business aim; the adjective means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "Highly negotiable, if another route meets the need", từ "meet" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Highly negotiable, if another route meets the need", what does "meet" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: meet /miːt/ (động từ): đáp ứng. "Meet a need / a deadline / requirements" = đáp ứng nhu cầu / kịp hạn / đạt yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: meet /miːt/ (verb): to satisfy. "Meet a need / a deadline / requirements" means satisfying it.

items.question: Trong câu "The other half is communicating it without damaging the relationship.", từ "damage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The other half is communicating it without damaging the relationship.", what does "damage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): làm tổn hại. "Damage the relationship / reputation" = làm tổn hại mối quan hệ / uy tín.
items.explanationEn: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to harm. "Damage the relationship / reputation" means harming it.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not say no — state the trade-off.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not say no — state the trade-off.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ. "State the trade-off / your reason" = nêu rõ sự đánh đổi / lý do; danh từ: statement.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State the trade-off / your reason" means saying it clearly; noun: statement.

items.question: Trong câu "Propose a cheaper route to the same need.", từ "cheap" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Propose a cheaper route to the same need.", what does "cheap" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cheap /tʃiːp/ (tính từ): ít tốn kém. "A cheaper route" = cách ít tốn kém hơn; lưu ý "cheap" đôi khi mang nghĩa rẻ tiền, kém chất lượng.
items.explanationEn: cheap /tʃiːp/ (adjective): low in cost. "A cheaper route" costs less; note "cheap" can also mean low quality.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask a question rather than deliver a conclusion.", từ "deliver" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask a question rather than deliver a conclusion.", what does "deliver" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deliver /dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (động từ): đưa ra, trình bày. "Deliver a conclusion / a speech" = đưa ra kết luận / bài phát biểu; nghĩa khác: giao hàng.
items.explanationEn: deliver /dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (verb): to state or present. "Deliver a conclusion / a speech" means presenting it; another sense is bringing goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask a question rather than deliver a conclusion.", từ "conclusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask a question rather than deliver a conclusion.", what does "conclusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: conclusion /kənˈkluː.ʒən/ (danh từ): kết luận. "Jump to conclusions" = vội kết luận; hỏi lại thay vì áp đặt kết luận giúp giữ quan hệ.
items.explanationEn: conclusion /kənˈkluː.ʒən/ (noun): a final judgement. "Jump to conclusions" means deciding too fast; asking instead keeps the relationship healthy.

items.question: Trong câu "What NOT to do: refuse using technical reasons.", từ "refuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What NOT to do: refuse using technical reasons.", what does "refuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (động từ): từ chối. "Refuse a request" = từ chối yêu cầu; danh từ: refusal.
items.explanationEn: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (verb): to say no to. "Refuse a request" means saying no to it; noun: refusal.

items.question: Trong câu "sounds like an arbitrary refusal to someone without technical background.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sounds like an arbitrary refusal to someone without technical background.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (tính từ): tùy tiện, độc đoán. "An arbitrary decision" = quyết định tùy tiện; trong lập trình "arbitrary" còn nghĩa là bất kỳ.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (adjective): based on whim, not reason. "An arbitrary decision" has no clear reason; in programming it also means any.

items.question: Trong câu "sounds like an arbitrary refusal to someone without technical background.", từ "background" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sounds like an arbitrary refusal to someone without technical background.", what does "background" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rear part of a picture
items.explanation: background /ˈbæk.ɡraʊnd/ (danh từ): nền tảng kiến thức. "Technical background" = nền tảng kỹ thuật; "background check" = kiểm tra lý lịch.
items.explanationEn: background /ˈbæk.ɡraʊnd/ (noun): a person's training and experience. "Technical background" is technical training; "background check" means checking someone's history.

items.question: Trong câu "Always translate into business trade-off language.", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always translate into business trade-off language.", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
options: diễn đạt lại theo cách khác
items.explanation: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại theo cách khác. "Translate into business terms" = chuyển thành ngôn ngữ kinh doanh dễ hiểu (nghĩa bóng, không phải dịch tiếng).
items.explanationEn: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (verb): to put in other terms. "Translate into business terms" means expressing it in business language, not changing languages.

items.question: Trong câu "Asking why repeatedly is the most basic and effective way to step back from solution to problem.", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Asking why repeatedly is the most basic and effective way to step back from solution to problem.", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): nhiều lần liên tiếp. "Ask why repeatedly" = hỏi "tại sao" nhiều lần (kỹ thuật 5 Whys).
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (adverb): again and again. "Ask why repeatedly" is the idea behind the 5 Whys technique.

items.question: Trong câu "When a customer insists, ask whether there is another reason this approach is mandatory before concluding they are wrong.", từ "conclude" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a customer insists, ask whether there is another reason this approach is mandatory before concluding they are wrong.", what does "conclude" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: conclude /kənˈkluːd/ (động từ): kết luận. "Conclude that..." = đi đến kết luận rằng…; nghĩa khác: kết thúc (conclude a meeting).
items.explanationEn: conclude /kənˈkluːd/ (verb): to decide after thinking. "Conclude that..." means reaching a judgement; it can also mean ending (conclude a meeting).

items.question: Trong câu "Four categories: need, want, constraint, personal preference — each with a different level of negotiability.", từ "category" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four categories: need, want, constraint, personal preference — each with a different level of negotiability.", what does "category" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (danh từ): nhóm, loại. "Fall into a category" = thuộc một nhóm; động từ: categorize (phân loại).
items.explanationEn: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (noun): a group of similar things. "Fall into a category" means belonging to a group; verb: categorize.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's core work is translating WANT into NEED, and that is where the role's greatest value lies.", từ "lie" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's core work is translating WANT into NEED, and that is where the role's greatest value lies.", what does "lie" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lie /laɪ/ (động từ): nằm ở. "The value lies in..." = giá trị nằm ở…; lie (lay, lain) khác lie (lied) = nói dối.
items.explanationEn: lie /laɪ/ (verb): to be found in. "The value lies in..." means that is where it is; lie (lay, lain) differs from lie (lied) = tell untruths.

items.question: Trong câu "When WANT and NEED conflict, understand the reason behind the insistence rather than assuming stubbornness.", từ "stubbornness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When WANT and NEED conflict, understand the reason behind the insistence rather than assuming stubbornness.", what does "stubbornness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stubbornness /ˈstʌb.ən.nəs/ (danh từ): sự bướng bỉnh. Tính từ: stubborn (bướng bỉnh); đừng vội cho rằng khách hàng bướng, hãy tìm lý do.
items.explanationEn: stubbornness /ˈstʌb.ən.nəs/ (noun): refusal to change one's mind. Adjective: stubborn; do not assume a customer is stubborn before finding the reason.

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is not winning the argument but ensuring the decision is made with full information.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is not winning the argument but ensuring the decision is made with full information.", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡ.jə.mənt/ (danh từ): cuộc tranh luận. "Win an argument" = thắng tranh luận; trong lập trình "argument" = đối số truyền vào hàm.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡ.jə.mənt/ (noun): a dispute. "Win an argument" means coming out on top in a dispute; in programming it is a value passed to a function.
